name: Manhattanhenge
tagline: Finds when the sunset lines up with the street grid in any city, not just New York.

awards: Organizer's Choice Awards: Most Creative Impact

problem: The famous New York sunset-alignment moment likely has equivalents in other grid cities that nobody knows about.
solution: Search any city, see its street layout on a map, and compute the dates when the setting sun aligns with its streets.
demo_moment: Team-described: type a city and see its own 'henge' dates on the map.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Organizer's Choice Awards: Most Creative Impact” among 82 submissions.
Generalizes a well-known phenomenon to every city.
A solo, AI-free build won the organizers' creative award.

lessons: A delightful question ("is there a Torontohenge?") can beat bigger builds.
